column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah sisi E99002: Krassov menekan Lentine; latar belakang "Omen".
# Tetap Inggris: Krassov, Lentine, Roberti, Lisa, Kenny, Lonnie, Igla, Omen, Edge,
# Mokosh, Mangi Security, Griffin, Kryuger, Turul, Pradaja, Paradajz, Varjagers,
# Great Wall Railway, Leafcutter Brigade, Underground Brokers, URNC, P.M.C.,
# 'P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act', Doll, Neural cloud, Yellow Zone.
# Tag <size=..> dipertahankan persis — itu markup ukuran huruf milik game.
(In the Mangi Security executive office, Krassov slowly turned off the communication projection system and turned his gaze to Lentine, who was hesitating to speak in front of the desk.)
column2: (Di ruang kerja eksekutif Mangi Security, Krassov perlahan mematikan sistem proyeksi komunikasi dan mengalihkan pandangannya ke Lentine, yang berdiri ragu hendak bicara di depan meja.)

column1: ...Mr. Krassov, please look carefully at the combat plan I submitted again.
column2: ...Pak Krassov, tolong cermati sekali lagi rencana tempur yang saya ajukan.

column1: The dome Mokosh rebuilt relying on flood control facilities is a standard 'turtle shell', and a forced assault would be extremely costly. But this fully enclosed structure also dooms them to rely heavily on external supplies.
column2: Kubah yang dibangun ulang Mokosh dengan bertumpu pada fasilitas pengendali banjir itu 'tempurung kura-kura' yang khas, dan menyerbunya secara paksa akan sangat mahal. Tapi struktur yang tertutup rapat itu juga membuat mereka mau tak mau sangat bergantung pada pasokan dari luar.

column1: My suggestion is to completely cut off all overland supply lines around Mokosh, and cooperate with the military to implement a deadlocked siege on the periphery with triple the forces. In less than three months, they will collapse without a fight.
column2: Saran saya, putus total semua jalur pasokan darat di sekitar Mokosh, dan bekerja sama dengan militer menggelar pengepungan mati di pinggiran dengan pasukan tiga kali lipat. Kurang dari tiga bulan, mereka akan runtuh tanpa perlu bertempur.

column1: (Krassov dropped his usual relaxed demeanor and coldly bent his fingers, tapping out an unsettling, dull sound on the solid wood tabletop.)
column2: (Krassov menanggalkan sikap santainya yang biasa dan dengan dingin menekuk jarinya, mengetuk permukaan meja kayu solid itu dengan bunyi tumpul yang mengusik.)

column1: Weren't you listening during the video conference just now? The conglomerate executives have already given their resolution—it is not allowed.
column2: Kau tidak menyimak saat rapat video tadi? Para eksekutif konglomerat sudah mengambil keputusan—tidak diizinkan.

column1: What the Financial Conglomerate needs is not a siege that takes months. What we need is a clean and beautiful quick victory to prove to the URNC government the correctness of the "P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act" and the value of our Mangi Security.
column2: Yang dibutuhkan Financial Conglomerate bukan pengepungan berbulan-bulan. Yang kita butuhkan adalah kemenangan cepat yang bersih dan indah untuk membuktikan pada pemerintah URNC bahwa "P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act" itu tepat dan Mangi Security kita ini berharga.

column1: This is a war, not a business war or a political fashion show!
column2: Ini perang, bukan perang dagang atau pentas mode politik!

column1: Mokosh is easy to defend and hard to attack. Even if we have the advantage of a generational gap in weapons, with just the military strength and budget approved now, it's completely impossible to take it down in a short time!
column2: Mokosh itu mudah dipertahankan dan sulit direbut. Sekalipun kita unggul satu generasi dalam persenjataan, dengan kekuatan pasukan dan anggaran yang disetujui sekarang, mustahil merebutnya dalam waktu singkat!

column1: No, you're wrong, Lentine. This war, from beginning to end, is just a part of a commercial and political game.
column2: Tidak, kau keliru, Lentine. Perang ini, dari awal sampai akhir, hanya bagian dari permainan dagang dan politik.

column1: We are selling a product—a product called 'Mangi Security Armed Services', using it to grab more bargaining chips for the conglomerate within the URNC.
column2: Kita sedang menjual produk—produk bernama 'Jasa Bersenjata Mangi Security', memakainya untuk merebut lebih banyak posisi tawar bagi konglomerat di dalam URNC.

column1: You, me, the soldiers of Mangi Security, and those rebels in Mokosh... are all just chips on this gambling table.
column2: Kau, aku, para prajurit Mangi Security, dan para pemberontak di Mokosh itu... semuanya cuma cip di atas meja judi ini.

column1: Since it's a bargaining chip, we must exert its highest value... and keep winning.
column2: Karena namanya cip, kita harus memerasnya sampai nilai tertingginya... dan terus menang.

column1: The tactical deduction in your combat plan is perfect, and I personally appreciate it. However, every step of your optimization plan deviates from the consortium's demands.
column2: Perhitungan taktis dalam rencana tempurmu sempurna, dan secara pribadi aku menghargainya. Tapi setiap langkah rencana optimasimu menyimpang dari tuntutan konsorsium.

column1: Of course, your alternative plan of 'continuous heavy firepower coverage, leveling Mokosh to the ground' was also shot down.
column2: Tentu saja, rencana alternatifmu—'hujan daya tembak berat terus-menerus, ratakan Mokosh dengan tanah'—juga ditolak.

column1: Completely destroying Mokosh will detonate public opinion in the Yellow Zone, and will also waste the ready-made industrial production lines there... This absolutely does not conform to the conglomerate's policy of maximizing interests.
column2: Menghancurkan Mokosh sepenuhnya akan meledakkan opini publik di Yellow Zone, sekaligus menyia-nyiakan lini produksi industri yang sudah jadi di sana... Itu sama sekali tidak sesuai dengan kebijakan konglomerat untuk memaksimalkan keuntungan.

column1: ...I originally thought that putting the destruction plan up as a comparison would increase the passing rate of the siege plan.
column2: ...Awalnya saya pikir mengajukan rencana penghancuran sebagai pembanding akan menaikkan peluang rencana pengepungan itu disetujui.

column1: Mr. Krassov, you should know very well who we are facing... We will most likely have to face the Commander. He will absolutely not stand idly by, much less sit in a turtle shell waiting to die!
column2: Pak Krassov, Anda pasti sangat paham siapa yang kita hadapi... Kemungkinan besar kita akan berhadapan dengan Komandan itu. Dia sama sekali tidak akan tinggal diam, apalagi duduk di dalam tempurung menunggu ajal!

column1: The Commander... the young person Mr. Kryuger thinks most highly of...
column2: Komandan itu... orang muda yang paling dijunjung Tuan Kryuger...

column1: Although I haven't dealt with him, this person is indeed a rare tactical genius. Many people still haven't realized the threat he poses.
column2: Meski aku belum pernah berurusan dengannya, orang itu memang jenius taktik yang langka. Banyak orang masih belum menyadari betapa besar ancamannya.

column1: Lentine, it's precisely because he is here that we pushed you to your current position. Among us, you are the only one who has dealt with the Commander the most.
column2: Lentine, justru karena dia ada di sanalah kami mendorongmu ke posisimu sekarang. Di antara kita, hanya kau yang paling sering berurusan dengan Komandan itu.
...Saya...

column1: Listen well, Lentine.
column2: Dengar baik-baik, Lentine.

column1: The Financial Conglomerate's higher-ups want you to take over Mokosh's industrial facilities intact. At the same time, they want you to fight a beautiful war of annihilation—wiping out every single rebel inside without leaving a single one.
column2: Atasan Financial Conglomerate ingin kau mengambil alih fasilitas industri Mokosh dalam keadaan utuh. Sekaligus, mereka ingin kau memenangkan perang pemusnahan yang indah—membabat habis setiap pemberontak di dalamnya tanpa menyisakan satu pun.

column1: (Lentine could finally no longer contain the anger in her heart. She slammed both hands on the table, making a loud bang.)
column2: (Lentine akhirnya tak sanggup lagi menahan amarah di hatinya. Dia menggebrak meja dengan kedua tangannya, menimbulkan bunyi keras.)

column1: <size=30>Preserve the buildings and annihilate the defenders?! This is simply a fantasy!</size>
column2: <size=30>Bangunannya diselamatkan tapi pembelanya dimusnahkan?! Itu jelas khayalan!</size>

column1: <size=30>My subordinates and I are not numbers on the Financial Conglomerate's reports! This kind of battle with our hands tied, I...</size>
column2: <size=30>Saya dan anak buah saya bukan angka di laporan Financial Conglomerate! Pertempuran dengan tangan terikat seperti ini, saya...</size>

column1: Mangi Security needs to prove itself. For "Omen", and for you personally, this is a chance for a desperate comeback.
column2: Mangi Security perlu membuktikan dirinya. Bagi "Omen", dan bagi dirimu sendiri, ini kesempatan bangkit dari keterpurukan.

column1: I suggest you think clearly before continuing your speech.
column2: Kusarankan kau berpikir jernih sebelum melanjutkan ucapanmu.

column1: <size=18>...Sorry, I misspoke.</size>
column2: <size=18>...Maaf, saya salah bicara.</size>

column1: (Under Krassov's words, Lentine took a deep breath, forcefully calming her mood.)
column2: (Mendengar ucapan Krassov, Lentine menarik napas dalam, memaksa dirinya menenangkan diri.)

column1: Then, at least please allow me to cut off the possibility of Pradaja and Turul reinforcing Mokosh...
column2: Kalau begitu, setidaknya izinkan saya memutus kemungkinan Pradaja dan Turul mengirim bantuan ke Mokosh...

column1: Turul is now nominally managed by the Great Wall Railway Dispatch Station Garrison. As long as you don't directly bring the flames of war into Turul, feel free to do the rest...
column2: Turul sekarang secara nama dikelola Garnisun Stasiun Pengatur Great Wall Railway. Selama kau tidak membawa kobaran perang langsung ke Turul, sisanya terserah kau...

column1: As for that emerging tomato agricultural town—Paradajz, do as you please... I don't think that place holds any value.
column2: Soal kota pertanian tomat yang baru muncul itu—Paradajz, terserah kau saja... Kurasa tempat itu tidak punya nilai apa pun.

column1: Lentine, both the military and the financial conglomerate have high expectations for you right now, so don't let them down. Defeat the Commander and prove your worth.
column2: Lentine, militer maupun konglomerat keuangan saat ini sama-sama menaruh harapan besar padamu, jadi jangan mengecewakan mereka. Kalahkan Komandan itu dan buktikan nilaimu.

column1: Remember, you aren't the only command structure in this operation. The forces of other surrounding financial conglomerates will also 'coordinate' with your actions, and... the military's 'Leafcutter Brigade' will 'hold the line' on the periphery for you.
column2: Ingat, kau bukan satu-satunya struktur komando dalam operasi ini. Pasukan konglomerat keuangan lain di sekitar juga akan 'berkoordinasi' dengan gerakanmu, dan... 'Leafcutter Brigade' milik militer akan 'menjaga garis' di pinggiran untukmu.

column1: Cooperate... hold the line... sounds nice, but it's more like they're here to monitor us, hoping that we and Mokosh will both suffer heavy losses.
column2: Bekerja sama... menjaga garis... kedengarannya bagus, tapi lebih terasa mereka datang untuk mengawasi kita, berharap kita dan Mokosh sama-sama menderita kerugian besar.

column1: I understand... I will re-evaluate the combat policy and try my best to achieve the Financial Conglomerate's goals.
column2: Saya mengerti... Saya akan menilai ulang kebijakan tempurnya dan berusaha sekuat tenaga mencapai sasaran Financial Conglomerate.

column1: Not try your best, it's a must.
column2: Bukan berusaha sekuat tenaga, tapi harus.

column1: Believe me, you will get the glory you deserve.
column2: Percayalah, kau akan mendapat kemuliaan yang pantas kauterima.

column1: (Lentine dragged her legs, which felt like they were filled with lead, out of Krassov's office. Even she herself couldn't remember how she walked back to her command post in a daze all the way.)
column2: (Lentine menyeret kakinya yang terasa berisi timah keluar dari ruang kerja Krassov. Dia sendiri pun tak ingat bagaimana dia berjalan kembali ke pos komandonya dalam keadaan linglung sepanjang jalan.)

column1: (Until a cautious voice interrupted her thoughts.)
column2: (Sampai sebuah suara yang hati-hati memotong lamunannya.)

column1: Big Sis Lentine... are you okay? You look terrible.
column2: Kak Lentine... Anda tidak apa-apa? Wajah Anda buruk sekali.

column1: I'm okay.
column2: Aku tidak apa-apa.

column1: (Seeing Roberti's worried gaze, Lentine quickly takes a deep breath, locking all her weakness and helplessness back into the bottom of her heart, and regains the calmness a commander should have.)
column2: (Melihat tatapan cemas Roberti, Lentine cepat menarik napas dalam, mengunci kembali seluruh kelemahan dan ketidakberdayaannya di dasar hati, dan memulihkan ketenangan yang semestinya dimiliki seorang komandan.)

column1: How is the negotiation situation?
column2: Bagaimana hasil negosiasinya?

column1: Extremely bad. The consortium not only rejected the additional military budget quote, but also completely shot down the tactical plan I proposed.
column2: Sangat buruk. Konsorsium bukan cuma menolak pengajuan tambahan anggaran militer, tapi juga menolak mentah-mentah rencana taktis yang kuajukan.

column1: They demand that under the current conditions, we must not destroy Mokosh's core facilities, yet we must 'cleanly and efficiently' annihilate all the rebels.
column2: Mereka menuntut, dengan kondisi sekarang, kita tidak boleh menghancurkan fasilitas inti Mokosh, tapi harus memusnahkan semua pemberontaknya secara 'bersih dan efisien'.

column1: Not surprising at all. After all, the military budget you proposed at the beginning was enough to buy the entire Mangi Security before its expansion.
column2: Sama sekali tidak mengejutkan. Lagi pula anggaran militer yang Anda ajukan di awal itu cukup untuk membeli seluruh Mangi Security sebelum ekspansinya.

column1: When you submitted the application, I reminded you that this would be the result.
column2: Waktu Anda mengajukannya, saya sudah mengingatkan hasilnya akan begini.

column1: Just bargaining, at least we still squeezed out a little extra budget.
column2: Cuma tawar-menawar, setidaknya kita masih memeras sedikit anggaran tambahan.

column1: This is the armament list I redrafted. Roberti, once Lisa buys these loose parts back, immediately have the logistics team start modifying them.
column2: Ini daftar persenjataan yang kususun ulang. Roberti, begitu Lisa selesai membeli suku cadang lepas ini, langsung suruh tim logistik mulai memodifikasinya.

column1: (Roberti took the terminal Lentine handed over, and after seeing the items on the list clearly, she couldn't help but widen her eyes and gasp.)
column2: (Roberti menerima terminal yang disodorkan Lentine, dan setelah melihat jelas isi daftarnya, dia tak kuasa menahan diri untuk membelalak dan menahan napas.)

column1: ...High explosives... modification plan for EMP methods... Sister Lentine, do you plan to modify a suicide drone swarm?
column2: ...Bahan peledak tinggi... rencana modifikasi metode EMP... Kak Lentine, Anda berniat memodifikasi kawanan drone bunuh diri?

column1: ...Yes, sorry to make you do this kind of work.
column2: ...Ya, maaf harus menyuruhmu mengerjakan hal semacam ini.

column1: Lisa, everything on the purchase list must be in place. I know the bottom prices on the market, this list is definitely within budget.
column2: Lisa, semua yang ada di daftar belanja harus terpenuhi. Aku tahu harga dasar di pasaran, daftar ini pasti masih dalam anggaran.

column1: Wow, what a long list... why add so many cheap drones? Aren't the heavy mechs and tanks allocated to us enough?
column2: Wah, panjang sekali daftarnya... kenapa menambahkan begitu banyak drone murahan? Memangnya mech berat dan tank yang dialokasikan pada kita kurang?

column1: Besides, we already have advanced reconnaissance aircraft with optical camouflage and bunker busters sponsored by the military. Do we still need to buy this garbage?
column2: Lagi pula kita sudah punya pesawat pengintai canggih berkamuflase optik dan bom penembus bunker sumbangan militer. Apa masih perlu membeli barang rongsokan ini?

column1: The consortium forbids us from using heavy artillery to destroy Mokosh, yet forces us to get results quickly.
column2: Konsorsium melarang kita memakai artileri berat untuk menghancurkan Mokosh, tapi memaksa kita cepat menunjukkan hasil.

column1: The vast majority of weapons cannot shake Mokosh's dome... The number of bunker busters is limited.
column2: Sebagian besar senjata tidak mampu menggoyahkan kubah Mokosh... Jumlah bom penembus bunker pun terbatas.

column1: Since conventional saturation artillery strikes won't work, with the current quality of recruits, we can only force our way forward using creeping artillery barrages, infantry-tank coordination, and drone cover.
column2: Karena gempuran artileri jenuh yang konvensional tidak mempan, dengan mutu rekrutan yang ada sekarang, kita cuma bisa menerobos maju memakai tirai artileri merayap, koordinasi infanteri-tank, dan perlindungan drone.

column1: Although facing an opponent of the Commander's level, expecting recruits to gnaw hard at the defense line... heh.
column2: Meski menghadapi lawan selevel Komandan itu, berharap para rekrutan menggerogoti garis pertahanan... heh.

column1: (Lentine looked at the recruits' quality assessment on the screen and let out a sneer.)
column2: (Lentine menatap penilaian mutu para rekrutan di layar dan mendengus.)

column1: For victory, we can only use a massive amount of suicide drones to fill Mokosh's close-in fire net and forcibly tear open a gap!
column2: Demi kemenangan, kita cuma bisa memakai drone bunuh diri dalam jumlah masif untuk menjejali jaring tembak jarak dekat Mokosh dan merobek paksa sebuah celah!

column1: Then... adjust Igla's neural cloud parameters... This time, do not wipe her memories and neural cloud. I need her absolute power to complete the decapitation.
column2: Lalu... setel parameter neural cloud Igla... Kali ini, jangan hapus ingatan dan neural cloud-nya. Aku butuh kekuatan mutlaknya untuk menuntaskan pemenggalan itu.

column1: Understood~ Getting right on it.
column2: Dimengerti~ Langsung dikerjakan.

column1: Also, I need you to allocate three additional logistics transport units for me. No matter what method you use... even if you have to hire from the Underground Brokers, or forcibly seize the supply convoys of other conglomerate forces!
column2: Lalu, aku butuh kau mengalokasikan tiga unit angkut logistik tambahan untukku. Cara apa pun yang kaupakai... sekalipun harus menyewa dari Underground Brokers, atau merampas paksa konvoi pasokan pasukan konglomerat lain!

column1: To support this war of attrition strategy, we must ensure our supply lines are clear!
column2: Untuk menopang strategi perang gesekan ini, kita harus memastikan jalur pasokan kita lancar!

column1: You want me to play the bad guy again? Alright, I'll go see how much I can extort.
column2: Anda mau saya jadi orang jahat lagi? Baiklah, saya lihat dulu berapa banyak yang bisa saya peras.

column1: (Lentine swiped rapidly across the console with a cold expression, pushing a holographic tactical map marked with dense dashed lines in front of Kenny.)
column2: (Dengan ekspresi dingin Lentine menyapu konsol dengan cepat, mendorong peta taktis hologram bertanda garis putus-putus yang rapat ke hadapan Kenny.)

column1: According to this route map, set up supply transit stations and hidden sentries in all the dashed areas. While securing our logistics, cut off all of the enemy's material sources.
column2: Sesuai peta rute ini, dirikan stasiun transit pasokan dan pos jaga tersembunyi di semua area bergaris putus-putus. Sambil mengamankan logistik kita, putus semua sumber material musuh.

column1: You will oversee this part personally... especially in the direction of Paradajz.
column2: Bagian ini kau awasi sendiri... terutama ke arah Paradajz.

column1: Lonnie accidentally scouted there before. There's no way that person would just build a 'tomato farmer's market' in that godforsaken place on a whim.
column2: Lonnie tak sengaja pernah mengintai ke sana. Mustahil orang itu membangun 'pasar tani tomat' di tempat terkutuk begitu cuma karena iseng.

column1: Then it's either a hidden strategic material relay point... or a smokescreen used to cover some more deadly existence. We must keep a close eye on it!
column2: Jadi itu entah titik estafet material strategis yang tersembunyi... atau tabir asap untuk menutupi sesuatu yang jauh lebih mematikan. Kita harus mengawasinya ketat!

column1: But Commander Lentine... the current level of integration of this batch of recruits is really too terrible. It's very difficult to pull up such a long and dense blockade line.
column2: Tapi Komandan Lentine... tingkat kekompakan gelombang rekrutan ini benar-benar buruk sekali. Sangat sulit membentangkan garis blokade sepanjang dan serapat itu.

column1: Did you get any results from the prisoner I asked you to catch?
column2: Ada hasil dari tawanan yang kusuruh kau tangkap?

column1: ...Rather die than submit.
column2: ...Lebih baik mati daripada tunduk.

column1: More troublesome than I imagined...
column2: Lebih merepotkan dari bayanganku...

column1: The recruits' training report... tch...
column2: Laporan latihan para rekrutan... cih...

column1: The composition of those recruits is too mixed. There are exiled P.M.C.s, desperate bounty hunters, and displaced Varjagers gang members. This motley crew has absolutely no will to fight. They're fine fighting a winning battle, but once they encounter that person's tactical counterattack, the defense line will collapse instantly.
column2: Susunan rekrutan itu terlalu campur aduk. Ada P.M.C. buangan, pemburu bayaran yang kepepet, dan anggota geng Varjagers yang terlunta-lunta. Gerombolan campur-baur ini sama sekali tidak punya kehendak bertempur. Mereka baik-baik saja kalau menang, tapi begitu bertemu serangan balik taktis orang itu, garis pertahanannya akan runtuh seketika.

column1: (The command room fell into a deathly silence. Lentine lowered her eyes, remained silent for a long time, and her voice became somewhat dry.)
column2: (Ruang komando itu jatuh ke dalam kesunyian bagai kematian. Lentine menunduk, terdiam lama, dan suaranya jadi agak serak.)

column1: ...Omen... how many people are left?
column2: ...Omen... berapa orang yang tersisa?

column1: Including the recent additions... we barely have half of our past organizational strength.
column2: Termasuk tambahan yang baru... kita nyaris cuma punya separuh dari kekuatan organisasi kita dulu.

column1: (Hearing the number reported by Kenny, Lentine's expression didn't show any fluctuation. This cold statistic had always been etched in her mind, but she still chose to let Kenny say it himself, letting Kenny, who acted as a stabilizer, turn his words into a blade to remind herself of past failures.)
column2: (Mendengar angka yang dilaporkan Kenny, ekspresi Lentine tidak bergeming sedikit pun. Statistik dingin itu selalu terpatri di benaknya, tapi dia tetap memilih membiarkan Kenny sendiri yang mengucapkannya, membiarkan Kenny yang berperan sebagai penyeimbang mengubah kata-katanya jadi bilah pengingat akan kegagalan masa lalu.)

column1: (The shift in power dynamics from that day, as well as the drastic changes in the laws targeting P.M.C.s, ultimately led to the dissolution of Griffin and many of their peers. She had crawled and fought all the way for everything she believed in, trying to bring the ideal 'life' to these brothers and sisters.)
column2: (Pergeseran peta kekuasaan hari itu, serta perubahan drastis undang-undang yang menyasar P.M.C., pada akhirnya menyebabkan bubarnya Griffin dan banyak rekan sejawat mereka. Dia sudah merangkak dan bertempur sepanjang jalan demi semua yang dia yakini, berusaha membawa 'kehidupan' yang ideal bagi saudara-saudarinya itu.)

column1: (She isn't greedy; she just wants to let 'Omen' live the life they deserve... and ultimately free them from being 'Omen' to become the 'Edge' once again.)
column2: (Dia tidak serakah; dia cuma ingin 'Omen' menjalani hidup yang pantas mereka dapatkan... dan pada akhirnya membebaskan mereka dari status 'Omen' untuk kembali menjadi 'Edge'.)

column1: (And now she had finally endured until the implementation of the new firepower act. As long as she took this last step, the dignified life she had promised her "Omen" compatriots would be within reach.)
column2: (Dan sekarang akhirnya dia bertahan sampai undang-undang persenjataan baru itu diberlakukan. Asal dia melangkahkan kaki terakhir ini, hidup bermartabat yang dia janjikan pada saudara-saudari "Omen"-nya akan berada dalam jangkauan.)

column1: (But it was this last step, and what blocked her way was still that insurmountable high wall like a shadow.)
column2: (Tapi justru di langkah terakhir inilah, yang menghadang jalannya tetap tembok tinggi tak terpanjat yang membayanginya itu.)

column1: This is... Mangi Security's chance to climb up, and also our best chance...
column2: Ini... kesempatan Mangi Security untuk naik, sekaligus kesempatan terbaik kita...

column1: Heh... Mr. Krassov is right...
column2: Heh... Pak Krassov benar...

column1: We are all chips...
column2: Kita semua cuma cip...

column1: I've waited too long, too long for this opportunity to get on the card table... No matter what, I must win this round.
column2: Aku sudah terlalu lama, terlalu lama menunggu kesempatan naik ke meja judi ini... Apa pun yang terjadi, aku harus memenangkan ronde ini.

column1: Commander Lentine?
column2: Komandan Lentine?

column1: I'm fine, just remembered some old scores.
column2: Aku tidak apa-apa, cuma teringat beberapa perhitungan lama.

column1: Kenny, starting today, all recruits are forbidden to leave the camp. Add the highest intensity anti-Doll combat simulation training for them.
column2: Kenny, mulai hari ini semua rekrutan dilarang meninggalkan kemah. Tambahkan latihan simulasi tempur anti-Doll dengan intensitas tertinggi untuk mereka.

column1: Set all the actual combat data we've collected over the years about "Griffin Tactical Dolls"... all as imaginary enemies!
column2: Jadikan seluruh data tempur nyata soal "Griffin Tactical Doll" yang kita kumpulkan bertahun-tahun... semuanya sebagai musuh bayangan!

column1: This time, we will completely eradicate... the biggest obstacle blocking our way.
column2: Kali ini, kita akan mencabut sampai ke akarnya... penghalang terbesar di jalan kita.

column1: (Lentine stared fixedly at the coordinates representing Mokosh in the center of the electronic sand table. The gloom in her eyes was replaced by an almost paranoid fanaticism, a decisiveness of betting everything after being forced into a desperate situation.)
column2: (Lentine menatap lekat koordinat yang mewakili Mokosh di tengah meja pasir elektronik. Kesuraman di matanya digantikan kefanatikan yang nyaris paranoid, ketegasan orang yang mempertaruhkan segalanya setelah terdesak ke sudut.)

column1: That's right... this time, I will prove it with my own hands.
column2: Betul... kali ini, akan kubuktikan dengan tanganku sendiri.

column1: Commander... the path you abandoned back then for your ridiculous ideals, the glory and opportunities you disdained...
column2: Komandan... jalan yang dulu kautinggalkan demi cita-cita konyolmu, kemuliaan dan kesempatan yang kaupandang rendah...

column1: I will make you watch your mistakes with your own eyes, along with your naivety... become my stepping stones!
column2: Akan kubuat kau menyaksikan sendiri kesalahanmu, berikut kenaifanmu... menjadi batu loncatanku!
